tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Base of every frame, about 70% of the picture. The ground of the Ink theme. Text on Signal fills (5.9:1) and on Bone (16.5:1).

tokens.name: coal
tokens.usage: Raised ink: panels, the site's surface colour, swatch borders, and treelines and ground in pixel worlds. Bone text on it is 15.3:1.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Handheld console body, the darkest in-between shade of posterised game screens, and water and night shade in pixel worlds. Bone text 14.2:1, Signal 5.1:1.

tokens.name: ash-dark
tokens.usage: Dotted leaders, inactive chapter labels, console buttons, hairline rules on Ink (decorative only, 2.2:1). Muted text on Bone (7.7:1).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and credits on Ink (5.7:1) and Ink-2 (4.9:1). Not for text on Bone (2.9:1).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Type, about 20% of the picture: headlines, voice lines and labels on Ink (16.5:1). The ground of the Bone theme.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one accent, about 10%. In video, one orange thing per frame: Mo's shirt, an index number, a rule, a stat-label outline, a sticker fill or the wordmark dash. On the-thing.dev it also marks the CRT caret, primary buttons, experiment indices and the selected nav item. Text on Ink 5.9:1. On Bone use it only as a fill (2.8:1 as text).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page or frame ground.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines, voice lines and labels on `surface` (16.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, credits and secondary labels on `surface`: Ash on Ink 5.7:1, Ash-dark on Bone 7.7:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one orange thing per frame. As text only on the Ink theme (5.9:1); in the Bone theme use it as a fill with `on-accent` text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and borders on an `accent` fill: sticker type, avatar type (5.9:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Dotted leaders and quiet dividers. Decorative only; anything that carries meaning uses `text` or `accent`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on interactive brand pages: a solid 2px ring. Signal on Ink (5.9:1); Ink on Bone, where Signal would be 2.8:1.

tokens.name: pop-yellow
tokens.usage: Carousels only. The main highlight: key words in hooks, marked phrases in a DialogueCard, level chips and version chips. Ink text on it 12.8:1.

tokens.name: pop-pink
tokens.usage: Carousels only. Chips, tags, portrait grounds and pixel bugs. Ink text on it 6.4:1.

tokens.name: pop-teal
tokens.usage: Carousels only. Chips, tags, portrait grounds and pixel robots. Ink text on it 10.1:1.

tokens.name: pop-blue
tokens.usage: Carousels only. Portrait ground on yellow slides, pixel props. Ink text on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: pop-violet
tokens.usage: Carousels only. Pixel props and confetti. Ink text on it 4.7:1.

tokens.name: slide-violet
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for covers. Portrait `pop-yellow`. Bone hook 5.2:1. Anything smaller on it sits on a Bone card or a chip.

tokens.name: slide-teal
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for AI and robots. Portrait `pop-pink`. Bone hook 2.2:1, so the Ink hook shadow has to stay. Everything smaller on it is Ink (7.6:1).

tokens.name: slide-yellow
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for explainers. Portrait `pop-blue`. The one ground with an Ink hook (12.8:1), no shadow, and a Signal key word.

tokens.name: slide-green
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for Node.js. Portrait `pop-yellow`. Bone hook 2.9:1, so the Ink hook shadow has to stay. Everything smaller on it is Ink (5.6:1).

tokens.name: slide-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for PHP. Portrait `pop-pink`. Bone hook 3.9:1. Anything smaller on it sits on a Bone card or a chip.

tokens.name: slide-ocean
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for Alpine Linux. Portrait `pop-teal`. Bone hook 5.0:1. Anything smaller on it sits on a Bone card or a chip.

tokens.name: slide-pink
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for races and warnings. Portrait `pop-yellow`. Bone hook 2.6:1, so the Ink hook shadow has to stay. Everything smaller on it is Ink (6.4:1).

tokens.name: slide-blue
tokens.usage: Carousel ground for fixes and endings. Portrait `pop-pink`. Bone hook 2.7:1, so the Ink hook shadow has to stay. Everything smaller on it is Ink (6.1:1).

styles.name: arcade-title
styles.usage: Cover and end-card titles on 1080×1920 frames (story covers, link stories). Uppercase, ends with a full stop; the full stop or one word may be Signal.

styles.name: arcade-headline
styles.usage: The hook: uppercase, ends with a full stop, slams in on the beat. 150–176px in video, 168px for a scene hook over a pixel world.

styles.name: arcade-index
styles.usage: The number of an index tag, always two digits, in `accent`.

styles.name: arcade-sticker
styles.usage: Sticker type, `on-accent` on a Signal slab. 150px when it sets a yelled line in two rows.

styles.name: pixel-voice
styles.sample: Me and my guy. Quiet pond.
styles.usage: The plain-words line under a hook. Upright, sentence case, ligatures off (its fi ligature reads as A). 52–56px under a scene hook.

styles.name: quip
styles.usage: A line in a pixel speech bubble, in video (1080-wide frames). Ink on the Bone bubble, two lines at most. On the web it is 16px on desktop and 14px on phones.

styles.name: pixel-tagline
styles.usage: The lowercase series name beside the wordmark on the handheld, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: pixel-label
styles.usage: Index-tag labels, data rows and big data. Uppercase, words split with a middle dot. 40px for a data row under a pixel world.

styles.name: pixel-eyebrow
styles.usage: The small label over a cover or story title, after a 16px Signal square, in `text-muted`.

styles.name: pixel-caption
styles.usage: HUD labels, chapter rows on the handheld bezel, and captions under specimens.

styles.name: arabic-hook
styles.usage: The Arabic hook, set right to left: Handjet 900 is the chunky pixel weight that matches Jersey 10. Ends with a full stop; one word may be Signal. Never uppercase or letter-spaced (tracking breaks Arabic joins).

styles.name: arabic-voice
styles.sample: ثغرة ماكرة. إليك القصة بكلام بسيط.
styles.usage: The Arabic plain-words line under a hook. Weight 700 and the 1.3 line height keep the pixel strokes and the dots above and below letters readable; the second sentence may be text-muted.

styles.name: arabic-quip
styles.usage: An Arabic line in a Quip bubble. Use the bubble's --left variant in right-to-left scenes so the tail sits on the right, over the speaker's head.

styles.name: arabic-label
styles.usage: Arabic tags and labels, the Arabic counterpart of the Silkscreen labels. No letter-spacing.

styles.name: carousel-hook
styles.usage: The big hook on a 1080×1350 slide, 150–184px by length. Uppercase, Bone with `shadow-hook`, one key word in `pop-yellow`.

styles.name: carousel-number
styles.usage: The slide number, top left in every language, followed by "/08" at 46px.

styles.name: carousel-level
styles.usage: Text on a level chip, Ink on `pop-yellow`.

styles.name: carousel-name
styles.usage: The speaker's name under the portrait in a DialogueCard.

styles.name: carousel-swipe
styles.usage: The swipe cue on slide 1, next to a right-pointing arrow.

styles.name: carousel-body
styles.sample: It reads millions of lines of code and never gets bored.
styles.usage: The plain-words explanation in a DialogueCard. One or two short sentences, Ink on Bone (16.5:1). Marked phrases go to weight 800 on `pop-yellow`.

styles.name: carousel-quip
styles.usage: A line in a Quip bubble on a slide. Short and dry, and never the only place something important is said.

styles.name: carousel-tag
styles.usage: A tilted label on a picture, Ink on Bone or a `pop-*` fill.

styles.name: carousel-chip
styles.usage: A fact chip under the explanation, Ink on a `pop-*` fill. Two or three at most.

styles.name: carousel-source
styles.usage: The small source line under a number. 25–28px is the smallest type on a slide.

styles.name: carousel-ar-hook
styles.usage: The Arabic hook, 112–134px by length. Bone with `shadow-hook`. Never uppercase or letter-spaced. Hooks that are Latin names (Node2Shell) stay in Jersey 10.

styles.name: carousel-ar-body
styles.sample: ملف مضغوط خبيث يجعل Node يكتب خارج ذاكرته.
styles.usage: The Arabic explanation in a DialogueCard. The 1.3 line height keeps the dots above and below the letters clear.

styles.name: carousel-ar-level
styles.usage: Text on an Arabic level chip.

styles.name: carousel-ar-name
styles.usage: The speaker's name under the portrait.

styles.name: carousel-ar-swipe
styles.usage: The swipe cue on slide 1. It sits exactly where the English one does, with the arrow pointing right.

styles.name: carousel-ar-quip
styles.usage: An Arabic line in a Quip bubble on a slide.

styles.name: carousel-ar-tag
styles.usage: A tilted Arabic label on a picture.

styles.name: carousel-ar-chip
styles.usage: An Arabic fact chip under the explanation.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo only, never running text: MO and FAKHRII in Anton with a Signal bar for the dash. It stays Anton in every frame.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Stat label vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Stat label horizontal padding; gap between an index rule and its label.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Index tag gap on the reels; swatch padding on the brand sheet.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Gap between a big index number and its rule and label in 9:16 story frames.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: From an index tag or headline down to its voice line.

tokens.name: space-frame
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of every 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: The Bone offset slab behind a sticker. The only shadow in the brand: hard, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Raised A/B buttons on the handheld; removed while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-hook
tokens.usage: The Ink text shadow on carousel hooks (4px on the slide number). It carries hooks on the lighter grounds, so keep it.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The Ink slab behind a DialogueCard and other Bone panels on a slide.

tokens.name: shadow-tag
tokens.usage: The Ink slab behind a tilted tag.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: The Ink slab behind a fact chip.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Signal rules in section heads, index tags and the handle sign-off.

tokens.name: stroke-stat
tokens.usage: Stat label outline.

tokens.name: stroke-sticker
tokens.usage: Ink border between a sticker's Signal slab and its Bone shadow (8px at 210px type).

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Ink border of a DialogueCard and other Bone panels on a slide.

tokens.name: stroke-portrait
tokens.usage: Ink border of the portrait and level chip.

tokens.name: stroke-tag
tokens.usage: Ink border of tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything is square: stickers, stat labels, bubbles, covers, buttons, panels. Pixel art never rounds a corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Select and Start pills on the handheld.

tokens.name: radius-bezel
tokens.usage: Handheld screen bezel; its bottom-right corner uses `radius-bezel-corner`.

tokens.name: radius-bezel-corner
tokens.usage: Bottom-right corner of the handheld bezel.

tokens.name: radius-console
tokens.usage: Handheld body corners; the bottom-right uses `radius-console-corner`.

tokens.name: radius-console-corner
tokens.usage: The handheld's signature big bottom-right corner.

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Vertical video frame width (1080×1920).

tokens.name: frame-height
tokens.usage: Vertical video frame height.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Platform UI covers the top; only background above this line.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Captions and usernames cover the bottom; keep text above this line.

tokens.name: safe-right
tokens.usage: Right edge for text; like, comment and share buttons sit to the right from y ≈ 900.

tokens.name: headline-max-x
tokens.usage: Headlines stop here, clear of TikTok and Shorts buttons.

tokens.name: grid-band-top
tokens.usage: Top of the centre 3:4 band profile grids show; covers keep title and handle inside it.

tokens.name: grid-band-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the centre 3:4 band.

tokens.name: story-safe-top
tokens.usage: Stories: keep content below this line, clear of the progress bar and account row.

tokens.name: story-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Stories: keep content above this line, clear of the reply field (teasers without a reply field may run to 1700px).

tokens.name: carousel-width
tokens.usage: Instagram carousel slide width (4:5).

tokens.name: carousel-height
tokens.usage: Instagram carousel slide height.

tokens.name: carousel-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of a carousel slide.

tokens.name: carousel-card-top
tokens.usage: Top edge of the DialogueCard. Pictures stand on this line.

tokens.name: carousel-card-height
tokens.usage: Height of the DialogueCard, which ends 54px above the slide's bottom edge.

sprite.note: Super Mo and every pixel world are drawn in art pixels. These say how many screen pixels one art pixel takes. Always a whole number, so the art stays crisp.

tokens.name: mo-unit-desktop
tokens.usage: Super Mo on the-thing.dev at desktop size (a 72 × 96 canvas).

tokens.name: mo-unit-phone
tokens.usage: Super Mo on the-thing.dev on phones or short landscape screens (width ≤ 640px or height ≤ 500px).

tokens.name: mo-unit-story
tokens.usage: Super Mo on a 1080×1920 story or cover beside a button or a title (168 × 224).

tokens.name: mo-unit-scene
tokens.usage: A wide shot of a pixel world in a 1080-wide frame (about 135 art pixels across). Closer shots use whole multiples: 12px for two characters, 18px for one, 34–42px for a face.

tokens.name: mo-unit-wallpaper
tokens.usage: Mo on a 1920×1080 desktop wallpaper (rendered at 2×); 8px on the 430-wide phone lock screen (rendered at 3×).

tokens.name: bubble-pixel
tokens.usage: One art pixel of a quip bubble's outline and tail in a 1080-wide frame. On the web the bubble's pixel follows Mo's (3px or 2px).

tokens.name: symbol-bubble-pixel
tokens.usage: One art pixel of a symbol bubble (! ? ♪ … ♥ ★ zZ ⛏ ✸ !?) in a 1080-wide frame; 14px in a face close-up.

tokens.name: mo-unit-portrait
tokens.usage: Mo's face in a DialogueCard portrait, cropped to a 176px square.
